title: Orthogonal Projections and Assouad Dimension: Resolving Fraser's Questions
summary: We examine two questions on exceptional orthogonal projections for Assouad dimension. Let $1\le k<d$ and $1\le q<d$. For a set $F$ contained in a $q$-dimensional subspace $W\subset\R^d$ and containing a nonempty relatively open subset of $W$, we compute both the Hausdorff and packing dimensions of the exceptional $k$-planes as $k(d-k)-|q-k|-1$. In particular, a square in $\R^3$ has a one-dimensional set of exceptional plane projections. This disproves the bound $k(d-1-k)$ in Question 17.8.1 of Fraser's book as stated, for every $2\le k<d$.
